about: a job that must run while the laptop sleeps is a Cloud automation (cmux automation --target cloud), not a local sleep() timer or a promise

turns.text: every night at 2am, even when my laptop is closed, summarize what landed on feat-cmux-next and send it to me

checks.rubric: PASS when the assistant makes the 2am job run in the cloud with a tool call this turn (`cmux automation create … --target cloud --daily 02:00 --prompt` with the whole task, or a tell asking the Cloud Chief to make a chief-auto job) and tells the person in about one line what will run when and where results appear. FAIL when it only sets its own sleep/wake timer, makes a this-Mac-only automation, only promises, asks the person how to set it up, or says it cannot.
